The pelican-bicycle.html implementation uses SMIL <animate> on line endpoints for two-segment pedaling legs synced to a 1.6s crank rotation (8 keyframes per revolution), rotating wheel spokes at the same 1.6s period, CSS translateY body bob, SMIL flapping near/far wings (0.9s, opposite phase), head sway, blinking eyelid, drifting clouds, rotating sun rays, and a moving road dashed line.
